senses.zh_definition: 哈利：英语人名或姓氏，具体指称由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English given name or surname, identifying a particular person according to context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama diri atau nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，实际书写通常为Harley。资料包没有提供DBP释义；此处为专名说明，不冒充DBP原文。不能仅凭这个词确定某一位名人。姓名来源参见：[Harley姓名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/harley)。以下搭配为自然示例，不代表经语料统计的高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 哈雷摩托车：在摩托车语境中，对Harley-Davidson品牌摩托车的非正式简称。
senses.ms_definition: Sebutan ringkas tidak rasmi bagi motosikal jenama Harley-Davidson.
senses.nuances: 这是依语境形成的品牌简称，不是所有摩托车的通称，也不能据此认定资料包中的harley一定指品牌。正式文字宜写全称Harley-Davidson。品牌及创办人背景参见：[Harley-Davidson Museum](https://www.harley-davidson.com/us/en/content/stories/harley-davidson-founders.html)。

etymology.historical_story: Harley has several surname histories. English branches derive from place names, including Harley in Shropshire, associated with Old English elements referring to stones and a woodland clearing; other branches have different origins. The motorcycle connection comes from William S. Harley, who worked with the Davidson family in Milwaukee. Their first motorcycle sale was in 1903. [Surname history](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=Harley), [Harley-Davidson Museum](https://www.harley-davidson.com/us/en/content/stories/harley-davidson-founders.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Harley读起来近“哈利”；看到人名想“哈利”，看到摩托车想“哈雷”，靠语境分清。
